---
title: "Weekly group update"
---


After each workgroup meeting, your group sends a short update email to your workgroup instructor. Take turns writing it, agree on the content as a group, and **always CC every group member**.

## Template

**Current status**

- Done this week:
- Next steps and who does what:

**Decisions and new agreements**

- Project decisions or changes to how we work / our contract:

**Group contract follow-up**

- Agreements not met (e.g., absence, not prepared, missed deadline) and what we did about it:
- Follow-up on earlier issues:

**Questions for the instructor** *(optional)*
